articles.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
articles.snippet: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

articles.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
articles.snippet: XRP tanked to its lowest level since November 2024 as ETF outflows and shrinking stablecoin supply add to pressure on crypto markets.

articles.title: Bitcoin crashes to 3-month low below $63,000 as analyst flags fourth capitulation wave
articles.snippet: "They are now selling at the very price they wish they had taken advantage of three months ago," wrote James Check.

articles.title: Strategy buys $33M in Bitcoin, spends $228M on STRC buybacks
articles.snippet: Strategy bought 485 Bitcoin for $33.4 million and spent $228.1 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, largely funded by new common stock sales.

articles.title: Singapore, Germany test cross-border FX settlement with CBDCs
articles.snippet: Project Simbolon aims to reduce the cost and time of cross-border settlement and promote common standards for payments and FX
